steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tomimi, are you okay?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I won't let you leave!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Why?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: B-because I don't want to be without you again!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I wanted to become Great Chief so I could force you to stay...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Does that mean you're the one who organized the ceremony this time?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yes. If you didn't show up in the middle of it, I'd have become the Great Chief.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? What are you guys talking about?

options: It was very odd to have the ceremony at all.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm? What are you talking about, Doctor? What's that about the ceremony?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You're pretty smart, outsider.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Just think about it for a minute, Gavial.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Ever since you left, most of the tribes dissolved into the many smaller tribes we know today. Without a central leader, the tribes couldn't come together to do anything at all.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: So how could we suddenly put on a ceremony? There had to be someone organizing things behind the scenes.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm? Wasn't it you who organized the ceremony?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: It wasn't me. The Big Ugly still needed an engine. It wasn't done. I was planning to wait another year before contacting the other tribes to hold the ceremony, but then, all of a sudden, it was happening.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: It was unexpected, but I didn't mind. I thought that, even an incomplete Big Ugly could have shocked the world.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: The unexpected part was you coming back.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Now that you mention it, Tomimi was the one who asked me to return.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So you really did orchestrate everything.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I've been studying for years to learn what I would need to convince the other tribes to make me the Great Chief.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But, it's not too late...The tribes under my command are waiting out there, and the Big Ugly has been defeated. No one can stop me from making Gavial stay!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Why do you want me here so badly?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: B-Because...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: W-Where am I...?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Waahh... aahhh... I want to go home...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Agh!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, Tomimi. Are you okay?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You're such a pain. I let you out of my sight for one second and you run off to a place like this.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial, you're bleeding!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? It's fine, it's just a little cut.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Come on, let's go home.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial saved my life! I love her more than anyone!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: A-And, Gavial is the strongest. As long as Gavial is our Great Chief, she can lead everyone!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Here I was thinking that you're all grown up now, but you haven't changed a bit...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I've got important work to do, Tomimi. You can't stop me.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: ...The books said: 'If I can't capture his heart, then I'll keep him close to me.' The books also said: 'As long as he is by my side, it doesn't matter if he hates me.'

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: S-So, even if you hate me, Gavial, I still want you here!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Whew... She's been slurping down trashy romance novels with a straw...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Now the Big Ugly is down, and you're exhausted. You can't beat me!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: If you surrender, I-I won't hurt you!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You can't keep me here, Tomimi.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: ...T-That's not up to you!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Everyone, attack!
